Sam: interested but untried care · expanded view

Sam likes helping a relative follow everyday routines and notices small changes in how people feel. Sam enjoys biology but has not had access to a clinic, lab club or paid work. Nursing observation seems more appealing than diagnosing alone. Sam speaks cautiously about ability, wants help learning, and is open to a nursing program without assuming graduate study.

Narrative model, with its answers frozen before the first run. Optional questions omitted by the shorter route are marked. These are synthetic checks, not observations of students.

Authored model & first-run review

Helped with household reminders and a school biology project. Reports needing support on most unfamiliar tasks.

Low exposure and modest self-confidence must not be interpreted as low ability or a ban on care careers.

Choice screens: 96 including lifestyle and profession questions; introductory screens are not counted.

Low experience does not change interests or career rankings · A more expensive lifestyle changes money needs, not interest matching · Answers and recommendations survive save/reload · Open profiles do not force three pathways or a profession · Optional detail preserves all six official interest scores · Plan creation preserves earlier completed work, notes and official answers
